clusters.name: listener-observability
clusters.executionModeRationale: Single implementer, serial. US-001 (listener-loop.js) and US-002 (mailbox.js) touch disjoint source files, but US-003's test imports both new helpers and US-004 stamps the shared version/CHANGELOG/AGENTS surface, so splitting across parallel members would create version-file and import conflicts for no throughput gain on a ~2-file change.
